content_data.meeting_title: Regional Energy Industry UX Pilot - Initial Research Synthesis and Next Steps
agenda_items: Discussion on key user pain points and opportunities identified
Review of preliminary user research findings from Phase 1
Planning for stakeholder engagement workshops (utility providers, consumers)
key_decisions: Focus initial technology intervention concepts on demand-side management and smart grid integration
Allocate resources for developing a prototype for a user-friendly energy consumption dashboard
action_items: Dr. Lena Petrova: Begin literature review on ethical considerations for AI in energy management and prepare a brief for the next meeting.
Dr. Kenji Tanaka: Draft a preliminary outline for the stakeholder engagement workshops, focusing on regional energy providers, within two weeks.
